diagnosis.one_to_four_blocks: insufficient read-ahead throughput misses the 60 us collective window
diagnosis.eight_or_more_blocks: resident polling and worker CTAs contend with the full-byte consumers; initial 12, 24, and 48 block probes regressed further
diagnosis.fundamental_issue: a CUDA CTA cannot relinquish occupancy while waiting for the next task, so eliminating launches converts an intermittent overlap kernel into permanent consumer interference
